name: Shannon
description: Pentests web apps and APIs you are authorized to test by reading their source, running real exploits, and reporting only findings with a working proof of concept.

skills.name: Exploit-Proven Findings
skills.description: Executes real exploits against the running app and includes only vulnerabilities confirmed with a reproducible proof of concept.

skills.name: Source-Informed Attacks
skills.description: Analyzes the app's source code to map attack paths, then tests injection, XSS, SSRF, and broken auth with browser and CLI tools.

skills.name: Authenticated Testing
skills.description: Tests behind login using configured credentials, login flows, TOTP, email authentication, focus areas, and rules of engagement.

skills.name: CI/CD Release Gates
skills.description: Runs from the official GitHub Action or GitLab CI/CD component, publishes findings, and gates releases on proven vulnerabilities.

skills.name: Multi-Format Reports
skills.description: Writes evidence-rich PDF and Markdown reports plus JSON and SARIF 2.1.0 output, with SARIF on by default for exploit-mode scans.
